messages.content: What actually happens during identity verification for creators?

It usually starts with a government-issued ID upload - passport, driver's license, or national ID card. Then most platforms add a liveness check, where you take a real-time selfie or short video to prove the ID actually matches a live person, not a stolen photo. Some platforms also cross-check the name on your ID against your payment method to reduce fraud. The whole thing typically takes a few minutes to submit, though review time varies from instant automated approval to a manual review that can take a day or two.
